description: Pinned, isolated smoke tests for catalogued resources. Each case runs in a disposable Docker container with no host mounts other than a temporary work directory.

cases.description: Fetch a pinned Catppuccin commit, validate every theme JSON, and place the files in an isolated OpenCode themes directory.
cases.script: set -euo pipefail; git init -q repo; cd repo; git remote add origin https://github.com/catppuccin/opencode.git; git fetch -q --depth 1 origin d5f409632e6294762925fae869ad0c96dc17cd8e; git checkout -q FETCH_HEAD; test -d themes; mkdir -p /work/home/.config/opencode/themes; count=0; while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do node -e 'JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8"))' "$f"; cp "$f" "/work/home/.config/opencode/themes/$(basename "$f")"; count=$((count+1)); done < <(find themes -name '*.json' -print0); echo "INSTALLED_THEMES=$count"; test "$count" -gt 0

cases.description: Run the pinned design-md-generator installer in preview mode.
Install the pinned npm package globally and confirm the CLI is on PATH.
cases.script: set -euo pipefail; npm install -g --no-fund --no-audit opencode-skill-creator@0.3.6; command -v opencode-skill-creator; npm ls -g --depth=0 opencode-skill-creator

cases.description: Install a pinned OpenCode plugin through the OpenCode CLI in a temporary HOME.
cases.script: set -euo pipefail; npm install -g --no-fund --no-audit opencode-ai@1.18.33; opencode --version; opencode plugin opencode-websearch@0.7.1 --global; grep -q 'opencode-websearch' /work/home/.config/opencode/opencode.json || grep -q 'opencode-websearch' /work/home/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc; echo PLUGIN_CONFIGURED
